cn_title: 贝塞斯达40周年Logo致敬《终结者》
subtitle: 从根源出发
summary: 贝塞斯达为成立40周年启用新Logo，设计致敬其早期《终结者》游戏。工作室随后凭《上古卷轴》奠定发展道路，如今仍有《上古卷轴6》《辐射5》等多项项目等待推进。
opus_summary: 贝塞斯达为成立40周年启用新Logo，设计致敬其早期《终结者》游戏。工作室随后凭《上古卷轴》奠定发展道路，如今仍有《上古卷轴6》《辐射5》等多项项目等待推进。

paragraphs.en: Bethesda has unveiled a new logo to celebrate the studio’s 40th anniversary.
paragraphs.cn: 贝塞斯达公布了一个新Logo，以庆祝工作室成立40周年。

paragraphs.en: “40 years of adventures” Bethesda said . “Here's to the worlds we've built together... and those still to come. We're marking the occasion with a logo inspired by our roots.”
paragraphs.cn: 贝塞斯达表示：「冒险40年。为我们共同构建的世界，以及尚待到来的世界举杯。我们正以一个受自身根源启发的Logo纪念这一时刻。」

paragraphs.en: That‘s a nod to Bethesda’s early life, long before it became a subsidiary of ZeniMax Media and, later, owned by Microsoft. It wasn’t its first game, but 1991 PC game The Terminator is still fondly remembered by fans old enough to have been messing about with MS-DOS at the time. The Terminator: 2029 followed in 1992, and The Terminator: Rampage in 1993. Simpler times.
paragraphs.cn: 这是对贝塞斯达早期岁月的一次致意；当时它远未成为ZeniMax Media的子公司，更尚未在后来被微软收购。这并非它的首款游戏，但1991年推出的PC游戏《终结者》至今仍为那些当年摆弄过MS-DOS的老玩家所怀念。1992年，《终结者：2029》紧随其后；1993年则是《终结者：Rampage》。那是更简单的时代。

paragraphs.en: The very first The Elder Scrolls video game, by the way, came out in 1994. The Elder Scrolls: Arena would set Bethesda on a patch that would change the game for the studio, and now, over 30 years later, fans are waiting for The Elder Scrolls 6 to come out in… 2028?
paragraphs.cn: 顺带一提，首款《上古卷轴》电子游戏于1994年推出。《上古卷轴：竞技场》让贝塞斯达踏上了一条足以改变工作室命运的道路；如今30多年过去，玩家仍在等待《上古卷轴6》于……2028年发售？

paragraphs.en: Bethesda’s love affair with The Terminator didn’t end with Rampage. The Terminator: Future Shock came out in 1995 (Todd Howard was the producer!). Less than a year later The Elder Scrolls II: Daggerfall hit PC. Bethesda’s final Terminator game, Skynet, came out in 1996. A generational run.
paragraphs.cn: 贝塞斯达对《终结者》的钟爱并未随着《终结者：Rampage》结束。1995年，《终结者：Future Shock》推出，制作人正是陶德·霍华德！不到一年后，《上古卷轴2：Daggerfall》登陆PC。贝塞斯达最后一款《终结者》游戏《终结者：Skynet》则于1996年推出。这是一段堪称一代人记忆的连作。

paragraphs.en: If you want to know more about Bethesda's Terminator games, we've got an excellent roundup of The Best, Worst, and Weirdest Terminator Games , and there's plenty of information about how they worked and the industry back then for you to dig into. Here's a snippet:
paragraphs.cn: 如果你想进一步了解贝塞斯达的《终结者》游戏，我们有一篇出色的汇总文章〈最佳、最差和最离奇的《终结者》游戏〉，其中包含大量可供深入了解这些游戏如何运作以及当时行业状况的资料。以下是一段摘录：

paragraphs.en: I do not think Bethesda is all of a sudden going to start making new Terminator games, by the way. This is just a fun nod to the studio’s past. In any case, it has a huge amount to be getting on with. Apart from The Elder Scrolls 6, it’s got Fallout 5, Fallout 3 and New Vegas remasters, Obsidian’s new Fallout game, more DLC for Starfield, and ongoing work on Fallout 76 to contend with. All this after Xbox’s recent “reset” of its business and all the layoffs that came with it.
paragraphs.cn: 顺带一提，我并不认为贝塞斯达会突然开始制作新的《终结者》游戏；这只是一次对工作室过去的有趣致意。无论如何，它都有大量工作要推进：除了《上古卷轴6》，还有《辐射5》、《辐射3》和《辐射：新维加斯》重制版、Obsidian的新《辐射》游戏、《星空》的更多DLC，以及持续推进的《辐射76》。而这一切都要在XBOX最近对业务进行「重置」及其随之而来的所有裁员之后完成。
